text:
divya: opening a single follow-up thread for the steady mem drift observed on prod-kv (shard-2) this morning around 06:05 UTC. noticed correlation with long sequence writes and higher p95 seq_len.
lee: uploaded traces + a small heap dump: gs://redwood/prof/2472402468/dump.tgz. early diff shows a bump in 32-64B allocations from persist.encoder stacks.
jonathan: thanks. immediate plan: 1) low-risk patch (pooling) to reduce alloc churn; 2) per-shard soft-residency guard design; 3) jemalloc tunables + compact cadence experiment. owners below.
sam_k: pooling branch started: feat/pool-idxbufs-2472. microbench locally shows ~30% drop in allocs for the encode hot path. will open PR after pairing with lee.
lee: flamegraph posted: gs://redwood/prof/2472402468/flame.svg. stack snippet: encoder.encode -> persist.write -> cache.entry. also seeing fragmentation markers in jemalloc stats.
alex: i'll run compact_every=3m on a small canary pool and capture residency_ratio + seq_len histograms. will post graphs by EOD.
jonathan: design note for soft-residency: make it shard-scoped, percentile-triggered (p95 seq_len), and additive margin over historical baseline. rollout: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full. rollback criteria: OOM rate >0.5% or tail latency increase >2x SLO. assigning ticket after we agree on margins.
ops-bot: canary deploy "pool-idxbufs-canary" started at 2472402500 (shards 2/20).
divya: owners & rough deadlines (added to the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/zzXY): profiling -> @lee -> Fri EOD; pooling PR -> @sam_k + lee -> tomorrow AM; soft-residency proto -> @jonathan -> Wed; compact/jemalloc canary -> @alex -> Thu.
lee: quick code snippet showing culprit alloc path:
``
func (e *Encoder) encode(x) {
  buf := make([]byte, 0, 256) // hot path allocs observed
  ...
}
``
divya: low-risk path: use sync.Pool for those buffers and ensure defer/put is done even on error paths. sam_k + lee to pair.
jonathan: creating tickets: RI-2751 (soft-residency design), RI-2752 (pool-idxbufs), RI-2753 (compact-cadence+jemalloc). will attach rollback playbook to RI-2751.
alex: recurring pattern observation: similar slow climbs happen when concurrent clients >150 and p95 seq_len >900. adding a monitoring alert to detect that combined signal.
sam_k: PR opened: https://git.redwood/feat/pool-idxbufs-2472. bench details in PR description.
divya: scheduling a short triage Thurs 08:30 PT to review canary metrics and close quick actions. I'll update the incident postmortem with owners/links after that meeting. thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: RI-2752 assigned to sam_k, due 2027-04-04.
